_comment: License fallback for repackaged repos that do not redeclare a license in their Hugging Face cardData. When a tracked repo's cardData.license is empty, fetch_licenses fills in the license declared by its upstream/original repo listed here. Only entries whose upstream license is confidently known are included; uncertain community repos are left as Review.

fallbacks.note: repackage of LTX-Video; upstream declares a custom 'other' license
